rerun_request: Switch E63 iterative counterfactual contract refinement from the prior Qwen GGUF run to the local Gemma4 checkpoint and rerun.

notes: The Gemma4 runner maps model.language_model.* checkpoint keys to Gemma4ForCausalLM text-only keys exactly.
The runner validates that language weights have zero non-lm-head missing keys and zero unexpected language keys.
The runner forces Gemma4 MoE experts to the eager implementation to avoid the default batched_mm 80GB allocation on E63-length prompts.
The parser now strips common <think>, <thought>, and <analysis> blocks before JSON extraction.

The Gemma4 runner now supports a BitsAndBytes 4-bit path with a no-standalone-lm-head text-only class, explicit two-GPU layer maps, NF4/FP4 selection, BF16/FP16/FP32 compute dtype selection, and optional compact prompts.
Compact E63 prompting reduces the first-round Gemma4 chat prompt from roughly 1414 chat-template tokens to roughly 676 tokens, but does not make the current 4-bit stack runnable for E63 generation.

environment_changes_made: Installed transformers==5.12.1 so AutoConfig recognizes model_type=gemma4.
Installed bitsandbytes==0.49.2 to satisfy vLLM BitsAndBytes version requirements.
claim_boundary: Gemma4 produced real local model output for one BF16 E63 raw-round smoke under a text-only Transformers loader with eager MoE, but it did not produce a parse-valid contract. The 4-bit Gemma4 path was implemented and smoke-tested, but E63 smoke generation failed before any contract output. No Gemma4 full-run E63 result was executed. This is engineering feasibility/blocker evidence, not model-quality evidence for the paper.
recommended_next_steps: Use a serving stack or quantized checkpoint that supports Gemma4 MoE efficiently without the eager Python expert loop.
Use a smaller Gemma-family model or a GGUF/AWQ/GPTQ variant that can complete 512-1024 token JSON outputs at practical speed.
If Gemma4 must be used on this machine, first build a schema-specific constrained decoder or shorter DSL prompt so contracts close within approximately 128 tokens.
Keep the prior Qwen GGUF E63 full-run as the valid full local-LLM E63 evidence until a Gemma4 full-run completes.
